items.headline: United beat Leeds 5-4 on penalties in Dublin friendly
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Leeds United 1-1 after extra time, winning 5-4 on penalties at Croke Park. Joshua Zirkzee scored.

items.headline: Carrick hopes three players available for AC Milan friendly
items.summary: Michael Carrick expressed hope that three unavailable players would be fit for the upcoming friendly against AC Milan.

items.headline: Marcus Rashford included in 26-man squad for AC Milan friendly
items.summary: Marcus Rashford returns to the squad for United's friendly against AC Milan in Wrocław.
